action.content: Write a funny song-style poem for kids about why you shouldn't eat a lot of sweets. The poem should have four sections, with each section marked with SECTION X.
action.label: context

action.content:
SECTION 1
Oh, the candy shop is calling, with a wrapper bright and sweet,
A chocolate bar, a lollipop, a treat that's hard to beat!
You grab a bag of gummy bears and stuff them in your mouth,
But wait! Your tummy starts to rumble, it's making quite a scowl!
It goes *gurgle-gurgle-gloop*, it sounds like a swampy bog,
You're dancing on your toes, but then you start to cough and cough!
The sugar rush is zooming fast, you're flying to the moon,
But then you crash right on the floor, and bump your silly spoon!

SECTION 2
SECTION 2
Now look at your front teeth, they're sparkling white and clean,
But after all that jelly beans, they're looking rather green!
The sugar bugs are having a party in your mouth,
They're building little castles and they're dancing round and round!
They're chewing on your enamel, they're making holes so deep,
And now you've got a toothache that you simply cannot keep!
The dentist says, "Oh no, my friend, you've eaten way too much,
I'm going to have to drill a hole and give you a big scratch!"

SECTION 3
SECTION 3
You feel so full of candy, you can't move your legs or arms,
You're stuck inside your pajamas, you're covered in sweet charms!
Your brain is fuzzy, like a cloud, you can't remember your name,
You tried to tie your shoelaces, but tied them in a flame!
You're bouncing off the ceiling, then you're sleeping on the rug,
You're waking up with sticky hands and a very sticky mug!
The energy is gone so fast, you're tired as a bat,
You wish you'd eaten broccoli instead of that sweet cat!

SECTION 4
SECTION 4
So listen to the lesson, before you eat the whole jar,
Too many sweets will make you feel like a wobbly, sticky star!
Eat an apple, eat a carrot, they make you strong and tall,
They won't make your tummy hurt or make your teeth fall!
Save the candy for a treat, just one or two a day,
Then you'll have a happy tummy and a smile that's bright and gay!
No more sugar crashes, no more bugs inside your head,
Just a healthy, happy kid who is ready for bed!
